[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:383YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>To relinquish the Imperial Bourse Seat ‘The Hunt of Alderei the Fair” that it may be later reassigned as a Varushkan National Position in a separate motion, at the request of the Varushkan people.
<br>''Proposed by Miekarova, seconded by Karov.''</ic>
==Outcome==
* This motion was to [[Powers_of_the_Imperial_Senate#Relinquishment|relinquish]] the [[Hunt of Alderei the Fair]] which is currently an [[Bourse#Imperial_Weirwood_Seats|Imperial Bourse Seat]] following an [[The_honey_offering#Proposal:_Buying_the_Hunt|offer]] from an affiliation of Varushkans
* Failed
==Date==
* Autumn 383YE
